# planetscale_neki_configuration_profile_parameters (Data Source)

Returns configurable parameters and their current values for a Neki configuration profile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "planetscale_neki_configuration_profile_parameters" "my_nekiconfigurationprofileparameters" {
  branch                = "...my_branch..."
  configuration_profile = "...my_configuration_profile..."
  database              = "...my_database..."
  organization          = "...my_organization..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch` (String)
- `configuration_profile` (String)
- `database` (String)
- `organization` (String)

### Read-Only
